newsitem.title: USA: MCI says AT&T-Bell plan would raise phone rates.
newsitem.headline: MCI says AT&T-Bell plan would raise phone rates.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said Friday a plan by AT&T Corp, Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp to reform access charges and universal service would "raise phone rates substantially for millions of Americans."
"The intent of the Telecommunications Act of 1996 was to lower, not raise, phone rates," MCI chief policy counsel Jonathan Sallet said in a statement.
"We remain opposed to any plan that requires American consumers and businesses to continue to subsidize monopoly profits," he said.
